about: Inputs, f64 references and tolerances for tests/path_integrator_test.slang, which runs every public function of common/path_integrator.slang once per case. OxidANT's crates/webgpu_renderer/tests/shader_vectors.rs and BeschleunigerBallett's C++ runner check it. The kernel reads two u32 header words (input words per case, output words per case), then each case's inputs in `inputs` order, one 32-bit word per component (an f32 as its IEEE bits, a u32 or i32 as the integer), and writes each case's outputs the same way in `outputs` order. An f32 output passes when |gpu - ref| <= abs + rel * |ref| in every component; a u32 or i32 output must be equal. Written by scripts/generate-shader-vectors.py from an f64 model of the module: edit that.
